title: Distributed estimation of many-body Hamiltonians via punctured surface code
summary: We study how a punctured surface code can turn many local $Z$-type couplings into one protected logical signal for distributed quantum metrology, where the goal is to estimate a weighted sum of the coupling strengths. We consider an ordinary planar patch with two $X$-cut holes and develop a distributed sensing protocol in which all $Z$-type couplings correspond to the same nontrivial logical $\bar{Z}$ of the punctured surface code.
